name: gptpro
description: ChatGPT Pro collaboration through an isolated loopback-only Desktop Electron Runner and one approved inline repository snapshot.

interface.shortDescription: Electron ChatGPT Pro with an approved inline code snapshot
interface.longDescription: For an explicitly requested plan, ask, review, debug, or architecture consultation, prepare one secret-scanned immutable Schema-6 inline repository snapshot, require exact or bounded standing approval, connect only to the isolated current-user gptpro Runner profile on loopback, resolve exact gpt-5-6-pro, send one normal-Chat user message, collect and import the response through its signed WebSocket handoff, and independently validate all advice. A conditional exact-current-branch GET may verify a signed result; GET response readback is explicit recovery only. Do not use gptpro for ordinary Codex work or OpenAI API calls. The ordinary ChatGPT app does not need to be relaunched. Browser, Computer Use, manual Send/Copy, custom ChatGPT Apps, Developer Mode, MCP, Secure MCP Tunnel, local functions, server tools, writes, shell commands, conversation continuation, and automatic resend are not supported.
defaultPrompt: Use $gptpro to prepare and run an approved Electron ChatGPT Pro review with one immutable inline repository snapshot.
Use $gptpro to send one approved inline repository snapshot without automatic resend or channel fallback.
Use $gptpro to independently validate the captured ChatGPT Pro advice before applying it.
